working_normalization: Weil-depth v0.3 (source preserved in archive/drafts/v0.1_2026-09-10/reference/weil-depth-v0.3/); independent normalization audit pending
meaning_of_certified: recorded guarded Arb sign test plus its stated analytic reduction, within the working normalization; not a proof audit, not formal verification, not a statement about zeros

records.claim: First quarter-step, L_q=(3/4)log 14, verification space 256+32, continuation R5. Absolute floor: largest passing three-figure m is 2.99e-29 (3.00e-29 fails). Relative test with inserted floor: M_0.9 >= 2.90e-29 (2.91e-29 fails), M_0.8 >= 2.67e-29 (2.68e-29 fails); with m=0 theta=0.78 passes and 0.76 fails. Comparison: H_J >= 1.13e-7 A (1.14e-7 fails). Hence Q_{0,L_q} >= 2.99e-29 I, R*F^{-1}R <= 0.78 H_J, H_J >= 2.90e-29 I, and Q_{0,L_q} >= 2.90e-29/tau^2 = 1.13e-29 I by the direct-floor lemma.
records.note: Re-evaluation of the stored 6144-bit R7 archive through the streaming dual-hash loader; reproduces the R7/R8/R10 outcomes at their fixed thresholds to every printed digit.

records.claim: Second quarter-step, L_2=log(56)/2, verification space 256+32+32, continuation R11. Comparison: H_{J_2} >= 5.01e-8 A_2 (5.02e-8 fails). Absolute test at 1e-36 fails (pivot 182); residual tests at theta=0.9, 0.95, 0.99 fail (pivots 55, 155, 174).
records.note: Failed sufficient tests are failures to certify, not negative-form witnesses.

records.claim: Ball Rayleigh upper bounds: lambda_min(Q_{0,L_q}) <= 3.29e-29 (quotient 3.28379e-29 + eta), lambda_min(Q_{0,L_2}) <= 1.89e-30 (quotient 1.88423e-30 + eta). Hypothetical-floor diagnostics at L_2: with the certified three-interval complement floor replaced by 0.55 the absolute (m=1e-36) and residual (theta=0.9) tests pass; with 0.5 both fail; with 0.65 the residual test at theta=0.8 passes and the largest passing absolute floor is 1.64e-30 (bisected), against the rigorous upper bound 1.89e-30.
records.interpretation: The upper bounds are certificates within the working normalization. The hypothetical-floor runs are DIAGNOSTICS of the finite matrices only and certify nothing; they show the second-step failure is entirely the analytic complement floor.

records.claim: Fourier-side diagnostic for the lowest eigenvector f_0 of the first-step head: 2*sum_{k<=K}|F_0(gamma_k)|^2 reaches 0.760, 0.918, 0.961, 0.978 of lambda_0=3.2838e-29 at K=100,400,1000,2000 (heights 237, 680, 1419, 2515), with a remainder scaling as 1/T; f_0(0)=f_0(L_q)=1.8e-14, jump at the join 1e-15; |F_0(gamma_k)| <= 1e-18 for k<=13; leading-order zero displacement contradicting the certificate: 9.6e-13 (k=1), 3.7e-11 (k=2), 3.1e-10 (k=3), ..., 1.0e-3 (k=12), 0.10 (k=17).
records.interpretation: Midpoints and mpmath only; not a certificate. Supports the reading that the near-null space at L_q is a low-zero interpolation phenomenon and that the certificate constrains zeros only below height about 70.

records.claim: First step rebuilt with 96 slab modes (256+96; two-interval complement floor 1.109; absolute test passes at 1e-30) and second step 256+96+96 at L_2=log(56)/2 (three-interval complement floor 0.76828, theta=0.9 modification 0.66537). Certified: absolute floor 1.69e-30 (1.70e-30 fails); relative M_0.9 >= 1.65e-30 (1.66e-30 fails), theta=0.8 passes at m=0; comparison H_{J_2} >= 5.25e-8 A_2 (5.26e-8 fails); ball Rayleigh upper bound lambda_min(Q_{0,L_2}) <= 1.89e-30 (quotient 1.884216e-30). Hence 1.69e-30 <= lambda_min(Q_{0,L_2}) <= 1.89e-30, Q >= 1.65e-30/tau^2 = 6.0e-31 by the direct-floor lemma, and with C_{L_2} < 17.4886: Q_{s,L} >= 8.4e-31 for s <= 2e-16, ||V_{omega,L}|| <= exp(-8e-31 omega), D >= (1-exp(-1.6e-30 omega)) I for L <= L_2.
records.environment: Cloud container, Python 3.11.15, python-flint 0.9.0, FLINT 3.6.0, mpmath 1.4.1; builds 6144 bits (41 min first step, 85 min second step); replays 2048 bits.
records.note: Closes the second-step floor and residual premises left open by R11/R15. The 448-mode head's lowest eigenvalue agrees with the 320-mode head's to five digits; the extra slab modes were needed only for the analytic complement floor.

all_depth_induction: Conditional theorem with the direct-floor recurrence (Sec. 7.1); hypotheses verified for the first and second steps (R14, R18); indefinite residual control and nonaccumulation remain open.
largest_certified_horizon: L_2 = log(56)/2 = 2.0127 with floor 1.69e-30 (spatial, R18); at L_q = (3/4) log 14 the floor is 2.99e-29 (R14); the separate global R6 certificate at 1.98 has floor 1e-31
